integrity: The analytic proof supplies all-dimensional validity; no independent scientific validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Real dual balls on the squared-path graph; anchored-coordinate Lebesgue volume. The result is not a Mahler-product formula, and finite computational checks do not establish all-dimensional statements. Unindexed equivalent prior work may exist.
title: An arctangent volume law for the dual balls of squared-path Lipschitz-free spaces
